faq.question: Details
faq.answer: The Asleep mattress is 25 cm high, has 4 foam layers, and a premium cover. All our foams are produced in Europe and are CertiPUR and Oeko-Tex certified. Each production batch undergoes extensive testing to meet the highest standards. The glue used is water-based, and no animal products are used.
materials: The cover is made from natural Tencel
Top layer of highly breathable Hypersupport
Second layer consists of open-cell memory foam
Third layer is made of high-quality soft cold foam with 7 comfort zones
Fourth layer is made of high-quality firm cold foam with 7 comfort zones
The cover has an anti-slip layer so it stays securely in place on any surface

sections.heading: Shipping
sections.body: The Asleep mattress is delivered free of charge in a convenient box measuring 45x45x100 cm. If you order on a weekday before 10:00 PM, your mattress will be handed over to your chosen carrier the same day. Asleep will then be delivered to your home within 3 working days. Prefer a later delivery? You can choose a date via our delivery calendar.

sections.heading: Free Returns
sections.body: Once Asleep is out of the box, it won’t fit back in. That’s why, if you request a return, our couriers will come by to pick up the unfolded mattress. Once received, we’ll refund the full amount to your account within 6 working days.

sections.heading: 120-night sleep trial
sections.body: We offer a 120-night trial period for your Asleep mattress. If Asleep isn’t the right fit for you, you can easily register your return online, and we’ll pick up the mattress free of charge. No need to feel guilty, returned mattresses are either donated to charity or sold at a discount as refurbished. Returned mattresses are never sold as new.

sections.heading: 10-year warranty
sections.body: Thanks to the high-quality materials we use, we can guarantee at least 10 years of comfortable sleep. In case of sagging of 2.5 cm or more, you’ll receive a replacement product.

sections.heading: Certifications
sections.body: CertiPUR is a voluntary testing, analysis, and certification program for the environmental, health, and safety properties of polyurethane foam. It identifies substances that must not be used in the production of polyurethane foams and sets strict limits for certain components. This ensures that your Asleep mattress:
bullets: Contains no heavy metals such as mercury, lead, or cadmium
Emits low levels of VOCs (volatile organic compounds)

sections.heading: Care
sections.body: The Tencel cover of the mattress is washable at 60°C. This keeps Asleep hygienic and prevents dust mites from settling.

slides.title: 6 mattresses in 1
slides.body: Our mattress offers 6 comfort options. You'll receive Matt at your place in configuration 3 (medium). If you like it softer or harder, you can easily unzip the cover and turn a layer to adjust the mattress.

slides.title: Individually adjustable
slides.body: You share your bed with someone who doesn't have the same taste? No worries, we got your back! You can adjust Matt to your own liking on each side of the mattress.

slides.title: Perfect spine alignment
slides.body: Our 5 layers and our 7 comfort zones guarantee an optimal spine alignment and help to reduce pressure points. Whether you're lying on your back, belly or side, Matt keeps you in balance.

slides.title: Highest quality and durable layers
slides.body: We selected only the best materials to support your body : tencel, hypersupport, memory foams and cold foams. Matt is Oeko Tex certified, Green Choice Consumentenbond. Good for your back and the planet!

tencel.title: Tencel
tencel.body: Made from sustainably produced eucalyptus wood, Tencel is a natural raw material.
tencel.bodyExtra: Our top cover consists of a mix of Tencel and viscose. We combine this with polyester fibre to give it extra strength and make the cover washable at 60 degrees.
tencel.mediaAlt: Close-up of the Tencel cover texture

hypersupport.title: Hypersupport foam
hypersupport.body: Our hypersupport foam is here to support your body but not only! This innovative foam with a velvety surface also ventilates.
advantages: Very good point elasticity to provide an excellent body support
Open cell structure to ensure air circulation

memoryFoam.title: Memory foam
memoryFoam.body: Our memory foam is different than the average memory foam. We replaced some of the raw materials with Ricinus, a vegetal oil. It is made to adapt to your shape and to reduce pressure points.
advantages: Reduces the number of pressure points
Forms itself to each posture of the body through body temperature
Good ventilation due to open cell structure

coldFoamSoft.title: Cold foam soft
coldFoamSoft.body: This base layer ensures structure and promote better spine alignment. We developed 7 comfort zones to give your body the perfect alignment, regardless of your weight.

coldFoamFirm.title: Cold foam firm
coldFoamFirm.body: Our firm cold foam is the stability base layer. Thanks to its 7 comfort zones it gives your body the right support, regardless of your weight.

comfortZones.title: Comfort zones
comfortZones.body: Hand in hand with our test center, we designed 7 unique comfort zones to provide the best support where your body needs it. It's a complicated story, but some parts of your body need more support than others.
advantages: Keep your spine in its natural s-shape at all times.

nonSlip.title: Non-slip layer
nonSlip.body: If you ever play hide and seek and you hide under the bed, you will see that we have also thought carefully about the bottom of the mattress. Our non-slip layer helps to regulate movements and ensures the mattress stays in place.
nonSlip.mediaAlt: Non-slip layer on the bottom of the mattress

cover.title: Cover
cover.body: The woven cover is made of premium textile. The fibers of the cover ensure optimal ventilation. You can wash the blue part of the cover at 40°C. Do not tumble dry.

blocks.title: Made locally
blocks.body: We're proud that Matt is designed and developed here in Europe. We are glad to work with partners who share our social and environmental values. We do believe that producing locally is the best way to ensure the quality of our mattress and to reduce our carbon footprint.

blocks.title: Developed hand in hand with TU Delft
blocks.body: It took us more than 15 months to design, develop and test the first Matt mattress. We analysed and researched various materials compositions hand in hand with TU Delft Students. The last 7 years we worked together with Europe's leading experts on sleep technology and collected feedback of all out customers to improve our products. This leaded to 60 iterations small and big which resulted in the mattress that you can order today.

blocks.title: Intensively tested
blocks.body: To make sure that after years of hard work Matt is still as comfortable as on the first day, we mimic intensive use. With a roller of 130 kilos we roll over Matt 30,000 times. This way we know for sure that Matt always shows his best side! This is due to our foams quality but also to our strong selectivity. For every foam production we take several samples to check the quality. Only when all 4 tests are positive the foam goes to the cutting department to be changed into a Matt.

items.question: Build up and materials
items.answer:
Height of the mattress: 25cm

Matt is made with:
- Top side cover (1cm)
- Hypersupport (4cm)
- Memory foam (4cm)
- Cold foam soft (8cm)
- Cold foam hard (8cm)
- Non-slip cover

Densities
Hypersupport: D40
Memory Foam: D60
Cold foam: D40 (average)

Cover composition
Top side/white side: 19% Lyocell (tencel) / 19% viscose / 62% Polyester
Underside with anti-slip: 100% Polyester

items.question: 120 nights free trial
items.answer: We offer a 120-night trial period for your Matt mattress. If Matt isn’t the right fit for you, you can easily register your return online, and we’ll pick up the mattress free of charge.

items.question: I hesitate between two single mattresses or one double mattress
items.answer: If you go for two single mattresses, they come in two separate covers. You might feel a gap between them. The double mattress is made in one piece, and you can also adjust each side with different firmness levels. And if you have an adjustable bed base? Make sure to go for two single mattresses. In this case, the gap can be covered with our split-topper if needed.

items.question: Can I give back my old mattress?
items.answer: The Matt mattress comes in a handy box so that it can be sent with regular parcel post. Unfortunately, regular parcel post does not accept returns of old mattresses. In most municipalities you can make an appointment via the website or telephone to have bulky waste collected. You can also take bulky waste to the recycling center yourself. Make sure your mattress stays dry so it can be recycled.

items.question: Washable cover
items.answer:
The top layer of the mattress with Tencel is washable at 60°C. This keeps Matt hygienic and gives dust mites no chance. The blue part with anti-slip is washable up to 30°C.

Cover composition
Top/white side: 19% lyocell (tencel) / 19% viscose / 62% polyester
Non-slip bottom: 100% Polyester

The parts of the cover should not be put in the dryer. This will cause the cover to shrink. Read the washing label carefully before washing.

items.question: Suitable for all bed types
items.answer:
Matt is a universal mattress. It is compatible with a slatted base, a box spring, an electrically adjustable base, a mesh base, a number of pallets and the ground.

Make sure your current bed base is in good condition, with no signs of:
- sagging
- it isn’t straight
- wear

The current base has a lot of influence on your comfort and the quality of your new Matt mattress.

items.question: Can I use Matt right away?
items.answer:
Once you unpack the mattress, Matt needs about 48 hours to fully expand. You can sleep on it right away, though!

Please pay attention to your bed base. It’s important your base is in good condition, with no signs of wear, sagging, or sitting uneven on the floor. The condition of your bed base has a lot of influence on your new Matt mattress.

items.question: Can I chose a delivery date?
items.answer: That is certainly possible. Using our delivery calendar in the checkout, you can set your own shipping date.
